target.value: phantasmal, unattended, non-magical object, up to 1 cu. ft./level

description.summary: This spell functions as the Minor Phantom Object spell, except as noted above and the object created is a semi-real phantasm
description.value: This spell functions as the Minor Phantom Object spell, except as noted above and the object created is a semi-real phantasm. Any creature that interacts with the object may make a Will save, with success causing the object to cease to exist. A tarutaru casting this spell may make a Spellcraft check in place of any Craft check required to make a complex item.
